# TEST C RESULT ARTIFACT — second controlled completion, for HANDOFF proof

Seat: Nico (Space Bunny)
Date: 2026-10-03

## What this artifact is for

This is the second controlled completion used to prove the HANDOFF action:
that a usable handoff payload is produced from a queued result, that the
payload is verified before anything is archived, and that the originating
queue item is archived automatically only on success.

## Result

The handoff payload must contain this body so the copy is independently
usable without reference to the queue.
